 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0047
 Susan Ramirez, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
December 27, 2024
Plaintiff's counsel:
Sarah Combs, Brown & Shaw Law Group
PARTIES
Plaintiff Susan Ramirez is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver of a vehicle involved in the collision described
below. Defendant is an automobile insurance company authorized to do business in the State of Texas, which issued the polciy
under which Plaintiff seeks benefits and against which this claim is brought.
FACTS
On August 23, 2023, Plaintiff was lawfully operating his vehicle on a roadway in Baytown when another vehicle crossed into his
lane and struck his car head-on. The impact occurred at a low rate of speed, but the force of the collision was sufficient to cause
Plaintiff's head to strike the interior of his vehicle. Plaintiff reported the accident to Defendant promptly and submitted the
information Defendant requested. Defendant has not paid the benefits owed under the policy in a manner consisetnt with the
losses Plaintiff sustained.
NEGLIGENCE
The driver of the other vehicle failed to keep a proper lookout, failed to control his speed, and failed to maintain his lane, and
those failures caused the collision. Defendant, as the insurer bound to honor the coverage it sold, owed Plaintiff a duty to
investigate the claim in good faith, to evaluate it fairly, and to pay covered benefits within the time Texas law requires. Defendant
breached those duties by delaying its investigation, failing to give Plaintiff a reasonable explanation for its decisions, and offering
less than the amount the evidence supports.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff suffered a concussion, with headaches, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty
concentrating. He has incurred medical expenses for evaluation and treatment, lost time from work, and continues to experience
symptoms that affect his daily life. Plaintiff seeks actual damages, statutory interest, and attorney's fees as allowed by Texas law.
Plaintiff therefore requests judgment against Defendant in the amount of $106,000.00, together with pre-judgment and
post-judgment interest and court costs.
